summary: Applied both spec-review blocking repairs by naming durable evidence artifacts for override completion and impl-gate judgment conversion.

items.title: Override evidence has no capture/persistence path and the no-new-CLI constraint forbids adding one
items.rationale: Defined `specs/<spec>/completion-overrides.json` as the durable step-keyed source for OverrideCompletionEvidence and clarified that validators read this artifact without adding user-facing CLI options.
items.evidence: spec.json overview.data_flow[2], requirements R3-R5, and acceptance_criteria now name `completion-overrides.json` and missing/invalid override behavior.

items.title: impl-gate is a mandatory contract target but has no persisted verdict artifact and run-gate.js is not a listed converter
items.rationale: Added `src/flow/lib/run-gate.js` as a converter target and defined `specs/<spec>/impl-gate-result.json` as the persisted impl-gate verdict artifact read by validators.
items.evidence: spec.json overview.modules, requirements R6, acceptance_criteria, implementationTargets, and T-3 implementation_notes now name `run-gate.js` and `impl-gate-result.json`.
